title: Passive to Active Voice: Rules — Quiz 112A
content:
## Passive to Active Voice: Rules

Review subjects, objects and verb forms when changing passive voice into active voice.

### Lesson focus

1. By whom → Who
2. Passive voice: S + HV + V3 + by + O
3. Active voice: O + HV + V1/V2 + S

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
